summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing Japanese notices regarding the continuation and expansion of its employee share-based compensation plans. The registrant announced a board decision to continue the Senior Professional/Senior Management Plan and introduce a new Key Talent Plan, using an existing ESOP trust. TMC will extend the trust term and contribute additional funds for share acquisition. This is an ordinary employee compensation matter, not a special situation. No premium, price, or deal terms apply. Watch for routine disclosures of trust share purchases, but there is no event-driven investment angle.
